Reference implementation for 3rdPS API vendors (HUD / chart specializations). Uses a st_thirdps_* key — not an Agent API (st_agent_*) key. See docs/THIRDPS_API.md.

Demo only. Paste a 3rdPS API key from POST /keys/thirdps or the thirdps_key field from /demo/keys (open API stack, port 8080). Never paste an Agent API key into a browser page. Production keys expire yearly/bi-yearly. Issuance is free (additional keys anytime for the same signer; one bill). You pay per usage in Curation Tokens (CT) (unused keys owe $0). Mixing charts + Seepnews + ingest on one key is n⁴. High usage is not a cutoff. Compromised keys still need wait or emergency revoke; a spare key lets you cut over immediately. Chain explorer is free. See docs/CURATION_TOKENS.md (informational, not a contract) and docs/API_KEY_LIFECYCLE.md.
